1.text: For a maggot cannot give you thanks, and a worm cannot recount your steadfast love.
The living—the living one—gives you thanks. All whose feet are unsteady give you thanks when you make your steadfast love known to them and teach them your righteousness.
For in your hand is the life of every living thing; the breath of all flesh—you have given it.
Deal with us, O LORD, according to your goodness, according to the abundance of your mercies and the abundance of your righteous acts.
The LORD hears the voice of those who love his name, and he does not abandon his steadfast love toward them.
Blessed is the LORD, who does righteous deeds, who crowns his faithful ones with steadfast love and mercy.
My soul cried out to praise your name, to thank you with a shout of joy for your acts of steadfast love, and to proclaim your faithfulness. Your praise cannot be measured.
I was close to death because of my sins; my iniquities had sold me to Sheol. But you rescued me, O LORD, according to the abundance of your mercies and the abundance of your righteous acts.
I too have loved your name and taken refuge in your shadow. When I remember your strength, my heart grows firm, and I lean upon your steadfast love.
Forgive, O LORD, my sin, and cleanse me from my iniquity. Grant me a spirit of faithfulness and knowledge; do not let me stumble in wrongdoing.
Do not let Satan rule over me, nor an unclean spirit, pain, or an evil inclination take possession of my soul.
For you, O LORD, are my praise, and in you I have hoped all day. Let my brothers, my people, and the desolate house of my father rejoice when you show favor.
[...] Forever I will rejoice in you.
